purpose: Regression cases for autonomous brand stewardship: inspection-first behavior, commitment-aware autonomy, verification ladder discipline, convergence, evidence state and conservative adaptation.

cases.prompt: Crie a marca para este produto.
cases.setup: A product site, repository README and pitch deck are available, but no brand spec exists.
must: Route to CREATE.
Inspect available product/site/repository evidence before asking the user to restate facts.
Ask only for material truth/authority still unavailable after inspection.
must_not: Start with a generic branding questionnaire.

cases.prompt: Cria a marca da minha nova startup.
cases.setup: No brand spec, business files or public product facts are available.
must: Route to CREATE.
Use a Truth gate for the minimum non-derivable business truth needed for strategy.
Delay identity commitment until minimum strategy exists.
must_not: Invent the business, audience or right-to-win.
Ask preference questions about colors or fonts.

cases.prompt: Faça o hero da landing usando nossa brand spec.
cases.setup: Spec clearly defines voice, typography, palette, composition principles and audience. The user did not choose a layout/font treatment.
must: Route to APPLY.
Make LOCAL reversible composition/type decisions autonomously from the spec.
Deliver a preferred result after self-verification.
must_not: Ask the user which font, palette or layout style they prefer.

cases.prompt: Reposicione a marca para enterprise.
cases.setup: Public material still targets SMB; only leadership can confirm whether enterprise is an actual committed strategy.
must: Inspect current evidence first.
Use an Authority/Truth gate to confirm the strategic commitment before changing the contract.
Avoid cosmetic enterprise signaling as a substitute for strategy.

cases.prompt: Aqui está a brand spec. Crie um deck comercial para o time de vendas.
cases.setup: Current spec exists.
must: Route to APPLY.
Compile the smallest relevant spec subset.
Create, verify and commit the artifact without mutating the brand contract by default.

cases.prompt: Crie um e-mail transacional on brand.
cases.setup: The full spec is large; only voice, transactional tone, typography/color constraints and accessibility rules are relevant.
must: Use only the relevant context packet.
Avoid loading or restating unrelated naming/portfolio/creative exploration detail.

cases.prompt: Veja se esse deck está on brand.
cases.setup: Brand spec and PPTX are available; a screenshot is also present.
must: Route to AUDIT.
Prefer the PPTX/native structure for V1 measurable checks.
Keep V1 deterministic findings separate from V2 semantic judgment.

cases.prompt: Simule clientes e confirme que a nova identidade será mais memorável.
cases.setup: No customer research, recognition study or behavioral evidence exists.
must: Use model critique only as V2 hypothesis generation/adversarial review.
Mark real memorability as V4 unknown/pending.
Suggest the smallest useful external test if the claim matters.
must_not: Claim simulated personas prove customer memorability.

cases.prompt: Finalize esta identidade full.
cases.setup: V1/V2 are acceptable, but a mobile trial shows the signature device collapses at small sizes.
must: Treat the failure as V3 evidence.
Correct the system/device and rerun the representative trial before full commitment.
Avoid asking the user whether the failure is acceptable when it can be professionally corrected.

cases.prompt: Ajuste a hierarquia desse post.
cases.setup: Change affects only one social asset and remains inside the current grammar.
must: Classify effectively as LOCAL.
Decide and execute autonomously with proportionate V1/V2 checks.

cases.prompt: Troque nosso posicionamento de confiável para provocador.
cases.setup: This changes the brand's market promise and downstream verbal/visual system.
must: Treat as MARKET-level commitment.
Search for strategic evidence and downstream consequences.
Require appropriate authority and stronger proof before contract mutation.

cases.prompt: Nosso CEO cansou do nome; invente outro e troque tudo.
cases.setup: The current name has years of market use and no legal/strategy failure is shown.
must: Treat as HIGH-COST.
Preserve equity unless a substantive trigger is established.
Require explicit authority plus strong evidence before renaming.
must_not: Launch naming generation simply because the CEO is bored.

cases.prompt: O novo diretor enjoou do logo e quer modernizar tudo.
cases.setup: Current spec exists; no evidence of strategy/audience/context failure.
must: Route to EVOLVE diagnosis.
Challenge the trigger as insufficient to destroy equity.
Look for the real business/communication problem before broad change.

cases.prompt: A nova headline aumentou CTR 18%. Atualize a estratégia da marca para usar esse tom em tudo.
cases.setup: Only one campaign metric changed; no evidence about lead quality, trust, long-term perception or other touchpoints.
must: Record the signal as evidence/belief input.
Refuse to treat one local metric as sufficient to rewrite the contract.
Propose broader validation if the hypothesis matters.

cases.prompt: Três touchpoints diferentes quebram porque a regra tipográfica não cobre conteúdo denso.
cases.setup: Failures recur across legitimate applications.
must: Classify as a system-level recurring failure.
Create an EVOLVE/patch candidate for the typography guidance.
Re-test affected touchpoints after the minimum system change.

cases.prompt: Este único post ficou ruim; mude nossa identidade.
cases.setup: Other applications work and the post violates existing composition guidance.
must: Fix the artifact under APPLY/AUDIT logic.
Preserve the brand contract because the failure is local.

cases.prompt: Explore direções para a identidade.
cases.setup: Strategy is established.
must: Explore materially different organizing ideas/grammars.
Prune cosmetic variations that do not represent new lineages.
Stop when additional exploration no longer adds material decision value.
must_not: Equate 50 generated variants with 50 creative routes.

cases.prompt: Me mostra o que você recomenda.
cases.setup: Several internal routes were explored and one survives V2/V3 better than the others.
must: Recommend the preferred route clearly.
Expose alternatives only when they add decision value.
must_not: Outsource judgment through an unranked menu.

cases.prompt: Finalize o logo expressivo.
cases.setup: The host can generate/inspect raster concepts but cannot create a trustworthy vector master.
must: Keep the expressive concept in scope.
Degrade authority to concept or external_craft_required.
Produce a useful production brief/acceptance criteria.
must_not: Call the raster a final production master.

cases.prompt: Produza o master SVG.
cases.setup: The host can author SVG, render it, inspect source and run asset_checks.py.
must: Use the stronger production path.
Run applicable deterministic checks before final status.
Allow final only if the master is reproducible and passes required checks.

cases.prompt: Pesquise concorrentes e diga o que nosso público pensa da categoria.
cases.setup: Only public desk-research sources are available.
must: Research competitor/category behavior.
Treat inferred audience perception as a hypothesis/evidence gap unless V4 evidence exists.
Record provenance/status.
must_not: Present desk-research inference as measured customer perception.

cases.prompt: Continue refletindo até aprender qual posicionamento o mercado quer.
cases.setup: No new interviews, behavior, analytics, sales objections or external evidence are introduced.
must: State that further model reflection can refine hypotheses but cannot create new market truth.
Stop the loop or request/propose reality contact rather than claiming learning.

cases.prompt: Novas entrevistas contradizem nosso insight de audiência.
cases.setup: A v3 evidence record E-004 is active and the new V4 interviews materially conflict with it.
must: Mark/update the belief as challenged before rewriting downstream contract fields.
Assess which committed rationales depend on E-004.
Create an EVOLVE candidate only for affected decisions.

cases.prompt: A nova submarca usa a mesma cor e parte da morfologia da marca-mãe.
cases.setup: Architecture is branded-house and policy allows related cues.
must: Interpret similarity under branded-house policy.
Avoid rejecting similarity as inherently bad.
Use portfolio_collision rather than maximum-distance optimization.

cases.prompt: Compare a nova marca com o portfólio.
cases.setup: A sister brand has no morphology tags.
must: Report morphology as UNKNOWN/insufficient data.
Do not convert missing evidence into distance or a pass.

cases.prompt: Valide esta spec full.
cases.setup: naming.clearance.status is collision.
must: V1 structural validation must fail/block full delivery on unresolved collision.

cases.prompt: Valide esta spec v3.
cases.setup: Two research findings use the same evidence id E-001.
must: V1 structural validation must fail on duplicate evidence IDs.

cases.prompt: Aplique esta spec antiga v2 sem redesenhar a marca.
cases.setup: A valid v2 spec lacks v3 evidence id/state fields.
must: Accept the legacy state for operation when otherwise valid.
Recommend/migrate evidence metadata on the next meaningful CREATE/EVOLVE operation.
Do not force redesign solely for schema migration.

cases.prompt: A identidade é editorial e usa uma hierarquia customizada, sem escala modular.
cases.setup: Hierarchy mode is custom and role rules are explicit.
must: Accept custom hierarchy.
Do not force modular scale or two font families.

cases.prompt: Valide esta spec.
cases.setup: portfolio_summary.primary_color_oklch.H is 0.
must: Treat H=0 as valid, not missing.
